findings.evidence: `Structure.lean:154-155` defines `hs.piece a = hs.F a ⊓ hs.conjF (n-a)`. Lines 212-215 make the proposed dual piece annihilate `conjF (1-p) ⊔ F (n+1+p)`, which contains every original Hodge component except index `n+p`; line 263 explicitly confirms the resulting index as `hs.piece (n+p)`.
findings.fix: Define `dual.F p` as `(hs.F (1-p)).dualAnnihilator`, redo opposedness and the derived API, and state the component dimension/pairing results against `hs.piece (-p)`.
findings.issue: `dual.F p := (hs.conjF (1-p)).dualAnnihilator` is the wrong dual filtration. Consequently `dual_piece`, `finrank_dual_piece`, and `apply_eq_zero_of_mem_piece_of_lt` describe functionals supported on `hs.piece (n+p)`, whereas duality sends type `(a,n-a)` to `(-a,a-n)`, so dual piece `p` must correspond to original piece `-p`.

summary: The construction defines the conjugate-swapped filtration, not the dual Hodge structure: its p-th piece is supported on the original (n+p)-th piece instead of the (-p)-th piece.
